capture_rgb_image: capture an RGB image from the LoCoBot Kinect RGB camera sensor in V-REP simulation
capture_depth_image: capture a depth image from the LoCoBot Kinect depth camera sensor in V-REP simulation
capture_rgb_and_depth: capture both RGB and depth images simultaneously from the LoCoBot Kinect camera sensors
set_camera_pan_tilt: set the pan and tilt joint angles of the LoCoBot head camera to specified values
get_camera_state: get the current pan and tilt joint angles of the LoCoBot head camera as a list
